raw: The current fix has reduced the misalignment but introduced a collision between the two doors. Since the fault is likely in the door’s hinge position or orientation, I will now attempt a small rotation around the Y-axis to adjust its alignment relative to the body and avoid interpenetration with the other door. A rotation of -5 degrees should help.

The rotation around Y did not resolve the jamming; the door still fails to close properly and remains misaligned. Since the fault is likely in the door’s hinge position or size, I will now attempt a small translation along the Z-axis to adjust its depth and allow it to close flush without interpenetration. A translation of -0.02 meters should help.

The translation along Z did not resolve the jamming; the door still fails to close properly and remains misaligned. Since the fault is likely in the door’s hinge position or orientation, I will now attempt a small rotation around the X-axis to adjust its alignment and allow it to close flush without interpenetration. A rotation of 3 degrees should help.

The rotation worsened the misalignment and increased the error. Since the door is still jamming and misaligned, I will now attempt a small translation along the Y-axis upward (positive Y) to adjust its position and allow it to close properly without interpenetration. A translation of +0.03 meters should help.
